title: inference-domain-is-in-the-device-list-and-answers-the-bus
intention: inference_domain stands in the device list so the command's lazy-init brings it up, and a bus request to it either answers within hex.local's latency or fails loudly — never hangs.
why: Measured 2026-09-06: no inference_domain process running; a bus request to it hangs 20s+; hex.local answers directly in under 5s with qwen2.5:7b. Codemother's 47-node root tree has a brain it cannot reach. The lived symptom is every chart packet this week carrying 'tree stratum unavailable' and counsel hanging on the bus.
how: Item 2 of the idea. inference_domain is entered in the rack's device list (the ground loop is heartbeat + device list, nothing more; the shim starts what is listed); its shim answers `infer` by forwarding to hex.local through the sole path it already owns (import_sieve); a request that finds no listener gets a refusal with the reason inside the bus client's timeout (10s), not a 20s hang. `cairn inference_domain status` reports the pid.
falsifier: DONE when: (1) after `cairn` lazy-init from a cold box, `cairn inference_domain status` shows a live pid; (2) `connect_bus().request('inference_domain', ['infer', ...])` from codemother's watch.py returns in under 10s with hex.local's answer; (3) with hex.local unreachable the same call returns a refusal naming the host inside 10s; (4) the next chart packet berthed carries a tree stratum instead of 'tree stratum unavailable'. WRONG INTENT if the hang is in the bus client's own timeout rather than the missing process — then the fix is the client's, and the ticket routes there.
traces_to: Law 7 — a hang is a silent error; a refusal is a loud one. Law 6 — inference_domain is the sole path to the inference host (residue: import_sieve); a path nobody can reach is an owner of nothing. Memory launch-chain-lazy-init: the command lazy-inits the system; a device not in the list is never inited.
watchme: none, because every chart packet under ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/ records whether the tree stratum was available — the grep for 'tree stratum unavailable' over new packets is the measure, and it is zero when this works
owner: inference_domain (cairn/devices/inference_domain) owns its process and its verbs; CC builds
